cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 527, you are at gate 211, you have received ATIS C, your destination is Guangzhou, contact Wuhan Delivery for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 527，位于 211 号登机口，已收到 ATIS C，目的地 Guangzhou，联系武汉放行请求 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 527, gate 211, information C, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 527，211 号登机口，信息 C，请求前往 Guangzhou 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3515.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，武汉放行，可以按计划航路前往 Guangzhou，离场跑道 36R，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3515, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Guangzhou，离场跑道 36R，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3515，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are on the taxiway Z4, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground and request taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在滑行道 Z4，准备滑行，联系武汉地面请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 527, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 527，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, follow CSN 737 on A7, you are number 2 for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，跟随 A7 上的 CSN 737，你是第 2 架离场。
cards.referenceText: Roger, follow CSN 737 on A7, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跟随 A7 上的 CSN 737，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at threshold of Runway 36R, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 36R 入口，准备离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 527, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 527，跑道 36R 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, surface wind 350, 5 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，跑道 36R 可以起飞，地面风 350，5 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Roger, cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 36R 可以起飞，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: B: After you just takeoff, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 刚起飞后，通过 600 米，联系 Wuhan Departure。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, Wuhan Departure, radar identified, climb to 3000 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，Wuhan Departure，雷达识别，爬升到 3000 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3000 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 3000 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at cruising level, the thunderstorm is detected in front of you, you want to make a fifteen miles deviation to the east of the current track from Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在巡航高度，前方探测到雷暴，你想向广州管制请求偏离当前航迹以东 15 海里。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA 527, our weather radar shows a CB ahead, request 15 miles to the east from current track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CCA 527，我们的气象雷达显示前方有 CB，请求从当前航迹向东偏置 15 海里。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, offset 15 miles to the east approved, when clear of whether, direct to ATAGA.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，批准向东偏置 15 海里，天气解除后，直飞 ATAGA。
cards.referenceText: Offset 15 miles to the east approved, when clear of whether, direct to ATAGA, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准向东偏置 15 海里，天气解除后，直飞 ATAGA，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, descend to 4200 meters when ready, reach 4200 meters 10 miles before ATAGA.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，准备好时下降到 4200 米，在 ATAGA 前 10 海里到达 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200 meters when ready, reach 4200 meters 10 miles before ATAGA.
cards.referenceTextZh: 准备好时下降到 4200 米，在 ATAGA 前 10 海里到达 4200 米。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, increase rate of descent to greater than 2000 feet per minute until passing 5700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，通过 5700 米前，增加下降率至大于每分钟 2000 英尺。
cards.referenceText: Increase rate of descent to greater than 2000 feet per minute until passing 5700 meters, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过 5700 米前，增加下降率至大于每分钟 2000 英尺，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are established with Guangzhou Approach, your assigned landing runway is 02 right, you want to land Runway 02L due performance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已与 广州进近 建立联系，指定着陆跑道为 02R，由于性能原因你想落跑道 02L。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CCA 527, request Runway 02L due performance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CCA 527，因性能原因请求跑道 02L。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, Runway 02L is not available due runway inspection, runway in use 02R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，跑道 02L 因跑道检查不可用，使用跑道 02R。

cards.audioText: B: You have established on the localizer Runway 02R, contact Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你已建立跑道 02R 航向道，联系 塔台。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CCA 527, established on the localizer Runway 02R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CCA 527，已建立跑道 02R 航向道。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, cleared to land 02 right, expedite vacating runway after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，跑道 02R 可以着陆，着陆后加快脱离跑道。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land 02R, expedite vacating runway after landing, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 02R 可以着陆，着陆后加快脱离跑道，CCA 527。
